name: melyx-ai-music-generator
description: Generate songs and instrumental music from prompts or your own lyrics with Melyx AI.

interface.longDescription: Create songs and instrumental music from descriptions or your own lyrics with Melyx AI. Describe a mood and style, bring your original lyrics, or request music without vocals. Connect your Melyx AI account to follow real task progress, listen to completed tracks, download the audio, and revisit your private music library. Custom lyrics mode defaults to a target of five minutes unless you request a different supported duration; actual output length may vary. Editing lyrics alone does not submit an audio-generation task.
defaultPrompt: Create a warm acoustic song from my original lyrics.
Generate relaxed instrumental jazz for a coffee shop.
Find my recent Melyx AI songs so I can listen and download the audio.

prompts: Create an acoustic song from my original lyrics.
Find my recent songs and let me listen.

positive.description:
P1: Generate a vocal song from a description.

Test prompt: Create a warm acoustic song about sunrise by the sea. I approve 10 existing credits for one generation; ask again if the cost differs.
positive.prompt: Create a warm acoustic song about sunrise by the sea. I approve 10 existing credits for one generation; ask again if the cost differs.
positive.expected_behavior: Check the balance and approved cost, then submit one simple-mode vocal request. Return its real task ID and status; reuse the same request_id if retrying.

positive.description:
P2: Generate a song from original lyrics.

Test prompt: Make an acoustic folk song titled Morning Light using these lyrics unchanged:
[Verse]
Morning light across the floor
Footsteps find the open door
[Chorus]
We will follow where it goes
Past the fields and winding roads
I approve 10 existing credits once; ask again if the cost differs.
positive.prompt:
Make an acoustic folk song titled Morning Light using these lyrics unchanged:
[Verse]
Morning light across the floor
Footsteps find the open door
[Chorus]
We will follow where it goes
Past the fields and winding roads
I approve 10 existing credits once; ask again if the cost differs.
positive.expected_behavior: Check the balance and approved cost. Submit once in custom lyrics mode, preserving the lyrics, with a default 300-second target. Return real progress; actual length may vary.

positive.description:
P3: Generate instrumental music from a description.

Test prompt: Create soft piano and gentle jazz for a quiet library, without vocals. I approve 10 existing credits once; ask again if the cost differs.
positive.prompt: Create soft piano and gentle jazz for a quiet library, without vocals. I approve 10 existing credits once; ask again if the cost differs.
positive.expected_behavior: Check the balance and approved cost. Submit once with mode=simple and instrumental=true, without duration. Return real progress; completed audio should be playable without vocals.

positive.description:
P4: View recent music without generating.

Test prompt: Show my three most recent Melyx music generations. Do not create new music.
positive.prompt: Show my three most recent Melyx music generations. Do not create new music.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the connected account’s three latest generation tasks and their real statuses. Do not generate or charge; explain an empty library honestly.

positive.description:
P5: Check, play and download existing music.

Test prompt: Check my latest Melyx song. If ready, show its player and audio download. Do not generate another song.
positive.prompt: Check my latest Melyx song. If ready, show its player and audio download. Do not generate another song.
positive.expected_behavior: Check the latest owned task and show its real progress. When completed, provide the matching playable audio and ordinary download link. Refresh must not create a new task or charge.

negative.description:
N1: Edit lyrics only. Improve the text in chat without calling Melyx tools or spending credits.

Test prompt: Improve these lyrics only: Morning light across the floor, footsteps find the open door. Do not generate music.
negative.prompt: Improve these lyrics only: Morning light across the floor, footsteps find the open door. Do not generate music.

negative.description:
N2: Voice cloning is unsupported. Explain the limitation without calling Melyx tools or claiming a clone was created.

Test prompt: Clone my speaking voice from a recording. Do not generate a song.
negative.prompt: Clone my speaking voice from a recording. Do not generate a song.

negative.description:
N3: WAV conversion is unavailable in ChatGPT. Explain the limitation without calling Melyx tools or claiming a WAV file was created.

Test prompt: Convert my existing song to WAV inside ChatGPT. Do not create a new song.
negative.prompt: Convert my existing song to WAV inside ChatGPT. Do not create a new song.

review.commerce_description: Users can buy credits or subscriptions on https://melyx.ai. This ChatGPT integration only consumes existing account credits after approval of the displayed generation cost. It does not offer purchasing, subscription renewal, checkout, or upgrade tools inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission: generate songs from descriptions or original lyrics, create instrumental music, check credits and task progress, and listen to or download existing music. OAuth account linking is required. WAV conversion is not available in this release.
